sentences.en: People were delighted at the safe return of the astronauts.
sentences.zh: 人们得知宇航员安全返回而感到高兴。

sentences.en: The speech made by the president yesterday delighted his supporters.
sentences.zh: 总统昨天发表的演讲让他的支持者们很高兴。

sentences.en: To see the sunrise from a mountaintop is a delight.
sentences.zh: 从山顶看日出是一种享受。
